item.title: Orlowski Signs With Hot Race
item.description: Hot Race is super happy to have World Champion, Michal Orlowski, for 2026 season.

item.title: Cavalieri Signs With Hitec
item.description: Hitec is thrilled to announce the signing of world-renowned driver, Ryan Cavalieri.

item.title: Cavalieri Signs With Alpha Plus
item.description: Alpha Plus is excited to announce that World Champion Ryan Cavalieri has officially joined the Alpha Plus factory team as a driver for the 2026 season and beyond.

item.title: New Upgrade RC Losi Micro Big Bore Shocks
item.description: UpGrade RC is pleased to announce front and rear Big Bore High Performance shocks for the Losi Micro-B and Micro-T now available at AMainHobbies.com or your local hobby shop.

item.title: Pietsch Joins Infinity Technical Department
item.description: Infinity is pleased to welcome Robert Pietsch, who officially joins their organization to support technical department.

item.title: 2026 Desert Classic Entries Open
item.description: Entries are now open for the 2026 Desert Classic hosted by Hobby Action RC Raceway.

item.title: New Zoo Racing Hyena LMH 190mm Body
item.description: ZooRacing presents the Hyena, the second hypercar body designed for the next generation of touring car racing.

item.title: Cadworx Development Pit Caddy 2.0
item.description: Introducing CADWORX Development's PIT DADDY V2, after one year of consistent development and customer feedback, they have decided to create a second generation.

item.title: New Infinity CFRP IF8B Shock Towers
item.description: The 5mm thick CFRP material improves the mounting angle of the Infinity IF8B Shocks gaining more precise cornering and improved rear stability.

item.title: Primal RC Performance Brand Introduction
item.description: Peach State Hobbies is proud to announce their new in house brand. Primal Performance RC specializes in bearings and more products coming soon.
